policy.canonicalWorldSource: Git-controlled reviewed geodata and scene specifications
policy.modelEvidenceRule: A reference may guide reconstruction without granting redistribution rights to its source asset.
policy.licenseRule: No third-party mesh or image enters shipped assets without an explicit reusable license or recorded permission.
policy.restrictedRule: Google Street View imagery, Google 3D geometry, and other restricted imagery are not automated ingestion sources.

sources.title: Design, Implementation, and Evaluation of a 3D Virtual Classroom Environment in a Computer Cluster
evidence: Paper states UPLB building models were patterned from architectural blueprints.
Paper states Google SketchUp and Blender were used.
Figures identify Baker Hall, Biological Sciences, CAS Annexes 1/2, Main Library, Physical Sciences, CEAT, CEM, CDC, DL Umali, Student Union, Mariang Banga, Oblation Park, Freedom Park, and UPLB Gate.
sources.nextAction: Contact UPLB ICS/CINTERLABS, project authors, and institutional archives for original .skp/.blend/.dae assets and blueprint-use provenance.

sources.title: CINTERLABS showcases 3D avatar-based virtual environment program
evidence: Contemporary report confirms the UPLB virtual campus beta and finished navigation assets for Main Library, Student Union, CAS, CAS Annexes 1/2, Physical Sciences, and Biological Sciences.
sources.nextAction: Use as corroboration when requesting recovery of the legacy project archive.

sources.title: UPLB Oblation 3D model
evidence: Description states capture from a DJI O3 Air Unit.
sources.nextAction: Contact creator for original asset, capture methodology, and explicit reuse/derivative permission.

sources.title: UPLB Physical Sciences Building 3D model
sources.nextAction: Contact creator; if permission is granted, retain scan as high-poly evidence/master input and generate optimized derivatives rather than shipping the raw scan.

sources.title: BERTUD: Building footprint extraction and regularization in LiDAR data
evidence: UPLB Phil-LiDAR 1 processed building footprints from LiDAR datasets for Laguna and MIMAROPA.
sources.nextAction: Ask ERSG/Phil-LiDAR custodians whether campus-covering point clouds, DSM/DTM, or derived footprints can be used for academic/noncommercial reconstruction.

sources.title: Seismic audit of important UPLB buildings—towards an earthquake resilient campus
evidence: Study references a prior risk assessment covering 67 of 165 UPLB buildings and notes structural-plan availability constraints.
sources.nextAction: Use building lists, construction-era information, and any lawfully available dimensions only; request plans separately where appropriate.

sources.title: Nonlinear static pushover analysis of the UPLB Main Library
evidence: Abstract identifies Main Library as a four-storey reinforced-concrete building built in 1970.
sources.nextAction: Use only disclosed factual dimensions/era information unless full-document use is separately authorized.

sources.title: Nonlinear static pushover analysis of the UPLB University Health Services Main Building
evidence: Abstract identifies UHS Main Building as approximately 8 m tall, two storeys, reinforced concrete, built in 1971.
sources.nextAction: Use disclosed factual information as a model-source clue; verify present-day condition before production.

sources.title: UPLB Baker Hall, 2017-02-16
sources.nextAction: Use for facade reference only if derivative obligations are understood and recorded; keep image attribution in the source manifest.

sources.title: UPLB Baker Memorial Hall, June 2023
sources.nextAction: Pin exact license/author metadata before any texture or derivative-image workflow.

sources.title: RealityScan
evidence: Current product supports image/laser-scan reconstruction and automation workflows.
sources.nextAction: Use for authorized hero-building capture when source recovery fails.

sources.title: COLMAP 4.x
evidence: Supports SfM, dense MVS, Poisson/Delaunay meshing, QEM simplification, and mesh texture mapping.
sources.nextAction: Use as reproducible/open photogrammetry path and as a validation alternative to proprietary reconstruction tools.
